name: Lost Museum -Kaigami Tsuisoutan-
source:
'Kaigami'
—is a being born from the feelings and memories embedded in the painting.

They all had grotesque heads, and the precious memories residing in those heads were missing.

Vince wandered into the museum where they lived, the 'Lost Museum.'

At the mansion, he obtained a mysterious 'Magic Pen' and through his interactions with
the Kaigami, he began to uncover the feelings embedded in the paintings and the mysteries of lost memories.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/5099440/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
“绘灵”
——是由寄宿于画作之中的情感与记忆孕育而生的存在。

他们全都长着奇形怪状的头颅，而原本栖息在头颅里的珍贵记忆却不翼而飞。

少年文斯误入了绘灵们栖居的美术馆——“失落美术馆”。

在馆内，他获得了一支不可思议的“魔法笔”，并在与绘灵们的交流互动中，一步步揭开封存于画作深处的思念与失落记忆的谜团。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/5099440/]Steam[/url]]
